entities.name: Charles Leclerc
entities.description: Leclerc is trilingual; he is fluent in French, Italian, and English. Outside of motor racing, he is interested in architecture, music, and fashion. He has released his own music on Spotify where he plays the piano. He chose 16 as his personal driver number in Formula One because the digits sum to his lucky number, 7, in addition to it also being his birth date—16 October.
